name: animated-number
title: Animated number
author: Sanjay Kumar <https://github.com/luv-jeri>
description: A smooth, interruptible number transition for totals, metrics and small moments of progress.

props.name: duration
props.description: Transition time in milliseconds, bounded to 0–2000 and scaled by Flow speed.

props.name: treatment
props.description: Count through values, roll each digit, or count in twelve drawn poses.

props.name: from
props.description: Optional starting value for the first visible entrance. SSR always shows the final value.

props.name: fallback
props.description: Text for NaN or infinite values; never presents missing data as zero.
